title: The Milkmaid and Her Pail
source: Aesop's Fables (public domain), gently retold for bedtime

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Once upon a time, on a little farm at the edge of a green valley, there lived a young milkmaid called Molly.
lines.speech: [warm, slow, smiling] Once upon a time... on a little farm, at the edge of a green valley, there lived a young milkmaid... called Molly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every morning, she milked Buttercup, the gentle brown cow, while the hens clucked and the sun came up over the hills.
lines.speech: [cheerful, storytelling] Every morning, she milked Buttercup, the gentle brown cow... while the hens clucked, and the sun came up over the hills!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: Good morning, Buttercup! What lovely creamy milk you've given me today.
lines.speech: [bright, cheerful, fond] Good morning, Buttercup! What lovely, creamy milk you've given me today!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Molly's mother gave her a kind smile.
lines.speech: [warm, tender storytelling] Molly's mother... gave her a kind smile.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Take the milk to market, my dear. Whatever you earn, you may keep.
lines.speech: [warm, motherly, smiling] Take the milk to market, my dear. [softly] Whatever you earn... you may keep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Molly set the pail of milk upon her head, and off she went, down the winding country lane.
lines.speech: [gently, with a smile] So Molly set the pail of milk upon her head... and off she went, down the winding country lane.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And as she walked, she began to dream.
lines.speech: [intrigued, warmly] And as she walked... she began to dream.

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: With the money from this milk, I'll buy some eggs.
lines.speech: [dreamy, thinking aloud] With the money from this milk... I'll buy some eggs.

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: The eggs will hatch into fluffy little chicks. And the chicks will grow into fine, fat hens!
lines.speech: [excited, imagining] The eggs will hatch into fluffy little chicks! [delighted] And the chicks will grow into fine, fat hens!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: I'll sell the hens, and buy a beautiful new dress. A blue one, with ribbons!
lines.speech: [delighted] I'll sell the hens... and buy a beautiful new dress. [dreamy] A blue one... with ribbons!

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: And when I wear it to the fair, everyone will look at me. And I'll just toss my head, like this!
lines.speech: [proud, playful] And when I wear it to the fair, everyone will look at me. [giggles] And I'll just toss my head... like this!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And Molly tossed her head. Splash! Down came the pail, and all the milk spilled out onto the lane.
lines.speech: [playful, hushed] And Molly tossed her head... [pause] Splash! [softly, sympathetic] Down came the pail... and all the milk spilled out onto the lane.

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: Oh no! The milk... and the eggs, and the chicks, and the hens, and my blue dress. All gone!
lines.speech: [gasps] Oh no! [sad] The milk... and the eggs, and the chicks, and the hens... and my blue dress. [sighs] All gone...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Molly walked slowly home, with her empty pail, and told her mother what had happened.
lines.speech: [gently, a little sad] Molly walked slowly home, with her empty pail... and told her mother what had happened.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Oh, my darling. Never mind. But remember, don't count your chickens before they are hatched.
lines.speech: [gentle, comforting] Oh, my darling. Never mind. [warmly, a soft smile] But remember... don't count your chickens before they are hatched.

lines.speaker: molly
lines.text: I'll remember, Mother. One step at a time.
lines.speech: [giggles softly, bright] I'll remember, Mother! [warmly, smiling] One step at a time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That evening, the sun set softly over the valley, and Buttercup lay down in the warm straw.
lines.speech: [calm, warm storytelling] That evening, the sun set softly over the valley... and Buttercup lay down in the warm straw.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The hens tucked their heads under their wings, and Molly curled up in her little bed by the window.
lines.speech: [sleepy, warm storytelling] The hens tucked their heads under their wings... and Molly curled up in her little bed, by the window.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And as the stars came out, she dreamed, not of dresses and fairs, but of tomorrow's sunny morning, one step at a time.
lines.speech: [very softly, slowly, dreamy] And as the stars came out, she dreamed... not of dresses and fairs, but of tomorrow's sunny morning... one step at a time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Goodnight, little one. Sweet dreams.
lines.speech: [whispers] Goodnight, little one... [whispers] Sweet dreams.
